neighbours.label: The final piece of a word split into several tokens (never|mind, Xin|jiang, e|ph|ed|rine), vs sentences whose words are all single tokens
fire: Oh, nevermind, I found the remote under the couch.
Harbin is the capital of Heilongjiang in the far northeast.
The pharmacist keeps ephedrine behind the counter.
My cousin moved to Zhejiang to teach English.
The nurse gave him amoxicillin for the ear infection.
We stopped in Kalamazoo on the drive to Chicago.
She took ibuprofen before the long flight.
Nanning is the largest city in Guangxi province.
quiet: Oh, wait, I found the remote under the couch.
The capital is a large city in the far northeast.
The pharmacist keeps the pills behind the counter.
My cousin moved to China to teach English.
The nurse gave him medicine for the ear infection.
We stopped in Detroit on the drive to Chicago.
She took a nap before the long flight.
Boston is the largest city in the state.
